title: Boltane store config (V2, migration 001)
description: The six per-store settings added to the stores table. Shared by Ava, the dashboard and the admin bot. Keys that are absent keep the database default. Other keys of a stores row are not covered here.

features.description: Per-store flag overrides: flag name -> true/false. Names must be registered in core/flags.py.

timezone.description: IANA name such as Asia/Damascus, or UTC. null = not configured (no open/closed claims).

business_hours.description: null = not configured. Otherwise all seven days; [] = closed all day; a close earlier than its open means past midnight; 24:00 is allowed as a close only.

billing_anchor.description: Date the monthly usage cycle is counted from. null = use the store's created_at.

owner_phone.description: The owner's WhatsApp number, digits only, no plus sign.
